source: a game where we can transform into princesses of all kinds what a map of a castle

image_prompt.text: The castle itself as the anchor of the map - towers and a gatehouse visible from anywhere on the grounds
A great hall or courtyard sized to hold a crowd of players without jamming, where everyone gathers between scenes
Composed royal spots built to be photographed in - a staircase, a balcony, a throne dais
The castle entered and played inside, not just admired from the grounds

layout_placement.text: A spot inside the castle where a player picks and transforms into one of the princesses

notes: Interiors are the cost here: the castle is the map, so it is entered rather than looked at, which routes P3.
'Princesses of all kinds' may mean recognisable characters from existing franchises; nothing in the layout depends on it but the build may.

open_questions.ask: Is the whole castle explorable inside, or is it a facade with one or two rooms?
Is there anything to do besides transform and roleplay - quests, a runway to show off on, a scoring round?

theme: Fairytale storybook royalty - bright stone, banners, gilt and chandeliers

coverage_missing.ask: How much of the castle is interior?
A single castle, or castle plus grounds and a village?
Is this a hang-out where you wear the outfits, or a dress-up round where they get judged?

answers.ask: Is the whole castle explorable inside, or is it a facade with one or two rooms?
answers.answer: Make it a small, explorable castle interior with the main rooms players would expect, rather than just a facade.

answers.ask: Is there anything to do besides transform and roleplay - quests, a runway to show off on, a scoring round?
answers.answer: The main activity is transforming into princesses and roleplaying in the castle; no quests, runway, or scoring round is needed.
